description.en: The ID of the migration job.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

- 迁移任务删除后不可恢复。
- 迁移任务删除后自动释放已创建的相关资源，如中转实例等。
descriptions.en:
## Description

- You cannot recover a migration job after it is deleted.

- When you delete a migration job, related resources such as intermediate instances are automatically released.
